'''Zittaasabba''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], when the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|attacked]] the coastal [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] in one of the final battles of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Zittaasabba was one of many Wookiees who fought to resist the invaders. Serving under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], Zittaasabba [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] an [[Oevvaor jet catamaran/Legends|Oevvaor jet catamaran]] through the lines of Confederate [[Tank/Legends|assault tanks]] during the battle. The Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] acted as co-pilot while two other crewmembers attacked the enemy with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and a heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] eventually surrendered to the combined forces of the Wookiees and their allies from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Zittaasabba was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|invaded]] the Wookiee [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in an attempt to secure [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] from a [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|guild]] of [[Navigator/Legends|navigators]] who resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]].<ref name="Cross sections" /> Wookiees from across Kashyyyk flocked to the coastal city to aid in its defense. Their efforts were organized and [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]], the leader of Kachirho, under whom<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Zittaasabba served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]].<ref name="Cross sections" /> The Wookiee forces were bolstered by support from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Confederacy's opponent in the war. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] arrived in Kachirho, and the joint forces established defensive positions on the city's [[Beach/Legends|beaches]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref>

The fighting began when Confederate [[Tank/Legends|assault vehicles]] crossed Kachirho's lagoon.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> Zittaasabba served as the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of an [[Oevvaor jet catamaran/Legends|Oevvaor jet catamaran]], an unarmed Wookiee [[Airspeeder/Legends|aerial vehicle]], during the fray. Fellow Wookiee [[Eugroothwa/Legends|Eugroothwa]] sat immediately to Zittaasabba's rear in the vehicle's starboard pod and utilized a portable heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], acting as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. [[Parent/Legends|Father]] and son warriors [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were in the catamaran's portside pod, throwing [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and co-piloting, respectively. Hundreds of catamarans darted through the lines of Confederate vehicles during the battle,<ref name="Cross sections" /> and, after a fierce skirmish, the Wookiee and Republic forces gained a considerable edge and forced the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to surrender.<ref name="Republic 82">[[Republic 82|''Republic'' 82]]</ref> The war itself [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|ended]] shortly thereafter.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

==Personality and traits==
Zittaasabba was one<ref name="Cross sections" /> of many Wookiees who volunteered to defend Kachirho from invading Confederate forces.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> The sergeant had [[Color/Legends|brown]] fur that was streaked with blond and white, and hair that was tied into braids which fell back behind the Wookiee's head.<ref name="Cross sections" />

==Skills and abilities==
In addition to being an expert in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]], Zittaasabba was an able pilot.<ref name="Cross sections" />

==Equipment==
During the battle on Kashyyyk, Zittaasabba flew an Oevvaor jet catamaran.<ref name="Cross sections" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zittaasabba was created by author [[Curtis Saxton]] and was introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in Saxton's [[2005]] reference book, ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''. The illustration of Zittaasabba was done by [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Cross sections" />
